ZpLo28nUUzvIG9KZjxzTLw.zh: 以色列報告1名9歲男童於今年8月底在加利利海庫爾西海灘(Kursi Beach)游泳,約1週後發病確診,截至9/6止仍於加護病房插管治療。此案為該國近年第3例,前2例均為2024年與加利利海周邊水上樂園有關個案,其中1例死亡、1例重症。病原通常經受污染暖淡水進入鼻腔後侵入腦部,不會經飲水或人際接觸傳播。因病程發展迅速,且致死率達97%以上,即時識別病人將影響後續療程。
ZpLo28nUUzvIG9KZjxzTLw.en: Israel has reported a 9-year-old boy who swam at Kursi Beach on the Sea of Galilee at the end of August this year. He developed symptoms and was diagnosed about a week later, and as of 6 September remained intubated in intensive care. This is the third case in the country in recent years; the previous two, both in 2024, were linked to water parks around the Sea of Galilee, one of which was fatal and one of which was severe. The pathogen usually enters the brain through the nasal cavity from contaminated warm fresh water, and is not transmitted through drinking water or person-to-person contact. Because the disease progresses rapidly and has a case fatality rate above 97%, early identification of patients will affect subsequent treatment.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

BcCN7JuDHSJftfYfS1g0tg.zh: 以色列特拉維夫區拉馬干市及耶路撒冷郊區,分別於8/12及8/18 確診1例犬隻病例。其中,拉馬干市染疫流浪犬(病毒基因型VIIA) 曾於公園咬傷居⺠,當局已緊急安排10名接觸者進行暴露後預防接種。以往疫情多集中於北部,近期逐漸向中部人口稠密區蔓延,恐加劇人畜頻繁接觸及染疫風險。該國今年累計已達91例動物確定病例,已高於去年同期之66例。
BcCN7JuDHSJftfYfS1g0tg.en: Israel confirmed one animal rabies case each in Ramla, in the Tel Aviv district, on 12 August, and in the outskirts of Jerusalem on 18 August. In Ramla, the infected stray dog (virus genotype VIIa) had bitten residents in a park, and authorities urgently arranged post-exposure vaccination for 10 contacts. Previous cases were concentrated in the north, but have recently spread to the densely populated central region, which may increase frequent human–animal contact and the risk of infection. This year the country has cumulatively recorded 91 confirmed animal cases, higher than the 66 cases in the same period last year.

4naWc7WSY5VSPQ-6-FDwQw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/21新增45例確定病例,其中13例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(38例)及北基伍省(7例),6/16-18期間新增3個受影響衛生區,有持續擴大情形。迄至6/21累計1,048例確定病例(267例死亡、112例康復),致死率25.5%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(954例)、北基伍(91例)及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約70.8%。 烏干達疫情更新,6/21新增1例確定病例,迄6/22累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、14例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 以色列近期報告2例自DRC返國之疑個案,分別收治於特拉維夫(Tel Aviv)與海法(Haifa)的醫院隔離治療中,尚無檢驗結果報告,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。 DRC西部奎盧省(Kwilu Province)布隆古(Bulungu)地區爆發不明原因疾病,過去兩週內已造成10至14例死亡,部分媒體稱另有20例病例。病患主要出現發燒、頭痛、嘔吐與腹瀉症狀。目前致病原不明,當局已將12件檢體送至國家生物醫學研究院(INRB)檢驗 。
4naWc7WSY5VSPQ-6-FDwQw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 21 June, 45 new confirmed cases were added, including 13 deaths, in Ituri Province (38 cases) and North Kivu Province (7). Between 16 and 18 June, 3 newly affected health zones were added, and the outbreak continues to expand. As of 21 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,048 (267 deaths, 112 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 25.5%. Cases are mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (954 cases), North Kivu (91) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 70.8%. Uganda update: 1 new confirmed case was reported on 21 June. As of 22 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 14 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in Kampala and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. Israel has recently reported 2 suspected cases returning from the DRC; they are being isolated in hospitals in Tel Aviv and Haifa, no test results have been reported yet, and authorities have started contact tracing. An unexplained illness has broken out in the Bulungu area of Kwilu Province in western DRC. In the past two weeks, 10 to 14 deaths have occurred, and some media report another 20 cases. Patients mainly present with fever, headache, vomiting and diarrhoea. The causative pathogen is still unknown, and authorities have sent 12 specimens to the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) for testing.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

AB8BAPN3ITYf3E6CKBN2XA.zh: 馬達加斯加報告首起疫情,西北部馬哈贊加市共計報告5例確定病例,病患皆接受治療中,當局已啟動緊急公衛行動中心,加強疫情監測及港口/機場等入境點之健康檢查作業,該國醫療系統資源有限,倘疫情擴散,可能限制診斷、治療及疫苗接種的因應能力。 以色列報告首例1b型境外移入病例,該病患具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已啟動疫情監測及接觸者追蹤作業,惟該國疫苗短缺已持續6個月,致無法及時提供高風險族群疫苗,呼籲民眾倘出現疑症狀,應立即接受檢測。
AB8BAPN3ITYf3E6CKBN2XA.en: Madagascar reported its first outbreak. In Mahajanga city in northwestern Madagascar, a total of 5 confirmed cases have been reported, and all are receiving treatment. Authorities have activated an emergency public health operations centre and strengthened surveillance and health screening at entry points such as ports and airports. The country's healthcare system has limited resources, and if the outbreak spreads, its capacity for diagnosis, treatment and vaccination may be restricted. Israel reported its first imported clade Ib case. The patient had travelled to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have activated surveillance and contact tracing. However, the country has had a vaccine shortage for six months, so high-risk groups cannot be vaccinated in a timely manner. People with suspicious symptoms are urged to get tested immediately.

0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.zh: 加拿大於11/10宣布PAHO通知該國不再維持自1998以來之麻疹消除狀態,該國自去(2024)年10月起爆發大規模跨區疫情,今(2025)年截至11/1共計10地區報告4,800例確診病例,其中2例死亡,雖近期疫情趨緩,惟已持續超過12個月,主要集中在疫苗接種率較低之社區,經PAHO委員會審查近期流行病學及實驗室數據,證實該國境內同一病毒株已持續傳播1年以上,當局已加強與PAHO及各地方政府合作,以提高疫苗接種率及強化監測措施。 澳大利亞西澳大利亞州今年截至11/6報告54例確診病例,主要分布於西南部和南部地區,病患皆有東南/南亞國外旅遊史或確診病例接觸史,為該州30年以來最嚴重疫情,2023-24年僅報告6例病例,當局已公布確定病例曾暴露之風險場所,建議造訪民眾應監測自身症狀。 紐西蘭今年截至11/7報告18例確診病例,近期新增病例多為本土病例,其中包含7例為藍橋渡輪(Bluebridge Ferry)群聚事件,當局已匡列逾3,000名接觸者,並提醒民眾疫情持續,建議民眾自身評估接種疫苗並密切留意相關症狀。 以色列今年截至11/10累計報告1,935例,其中9例死亡,疫情已傳播至少12個城市,當局已擴大疫苗接種資,並提醒倘出現相關症狀時,應立即就醫,另未完整接種疫苗者應避免參與爆發疫情城市之集會活動。
0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.en: On 10 November, Canada announced that PAHO had notified it that it no longer maintains measles elimination status, which it had held since 1998. The country has experienced a large-scale, multi-regional outbreak since October 2024. As of 1 November this year, 10 regions had reported 4,800 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Although the outbreak has slowed recently, it has persisted for more than 12 months, mainly in communities with lower vaccination rates. After the PAHO commission reviewed recent epidemiological and laboratory data, it confirmed that the same virus strain had been circulating in the country for more than one year. Authorities have strengthened cooperation with PAHO and local governments to raise vaccination rates and enhance surveillance. Australia: In Western Australia, 54 confirmed cases had been reported as of 6 November this year, mainly in the south-western and southern regions. All patients had either travel history to countries in South-East or South Asia or contact with a confirmed case. This is the state's most severe outbreak in 30 years; only six cases were reported in 2023–24. Authorities have published venues where confirmed cases were exposed, and recommend that visitors monitor their own symptoms. New Zealand: As of 7 November this year, 18 confirmed cases had been reported. Recent new cases are mostly locally acquired, including 7 cases from a Bluebridge Ferry cluster. Authorities have traced more than 3,000 contacts and reminded the public that the outbreak continues, recommending that people assess their own vaccination status and watch closely for related symptoms. Israel: As of 10 November this year, 1,935 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths. The outbreak has spread to at least 12 cities. Authorities have expanded vaccination and reminded people to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. People who are not fully vaccinated should avoid gatherings in cities with outbreaks.

YoHa_3lMXRXcabsD1AkckQ.zh: 以色列報告台拉維夫市2名醫師因治療1名未接種疫苗女童受到感染,目前醫師皆已被隔離,身體狀況良好且都有接種疫苗,相關接觸者均已接受預防性治療,刻正進行流行病學調查,該國今年迄今報告1,778例,其中8例死亡。
YoHa_3lMXRXcabsD1AkckQ.en: Israel reported that two physicians in Tel Aviv were infected while treating an unvaccinated girl. Both physicians are now in isolation; they are in good condition and both had been vaccinated. All close contacts have received preventive treatment, and an epidemiological investigation is under way. So far this year, Israel has reported 1,778 cases, including 8 deaths.

nl5EQOnwQzBGVZgEUiAxcQ.zh: 美國猶他州/亞利桑那州疫情擴大,截至10月下旬累計報告123例確診病例,多集中於猶他州赫利戴爾(Hildale)及亞利桑那州科羅拉多市(Colorado),多數病患為未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,該地區疫苗覆蓋率不到95%,迄今至少8例住院,無死亡案例,此波疫情為該國今年第2大群聚事件。 以色列新增1例併發症之死亡病例,為未接種疫苗之2歲半幼兒,且為該國今年第8例死亡病例,另該國南部報告1例重症個案,為6歲半且未接種疫苗兒童,目前仍使用呼吸器治療中。該國今年累計報告1,778例,其中574例住院,目前當局於疫情地區推展疫苗接種活動,除將第2劑疫苗提前至1歲半接種外(原為6歲),並建議居住或前往疫情地區之6-11個月大嬰兒應額外接種疫苗。
nl5EQOnwQzBGVZgEUiAxcQ.en: United States: The outbreak in Utah and Arizona has expanded. As of late October, 123 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mostly in Hildale, Utah, and Colorado City, Arizona. Most patients are unvaccinated school-age children, and vaccination coverage in the area is below 95%. At least 8 patients have been hospitalized and there have been no deaths. This outbreak is the country's second-largest cluster this year. Israel: One new death from complications was reported, in an unvaccinated two-and-a-half-year-old child, the country's eighth death this year. In addition, one severe case was reported in southern Israel, an unvaccinated six-and-a-half-year-old child who remains on a ventilator. Israel has reported 1,778 cases this year, including 574 hospitalizations. In the affected areas, authorities are carrying out vaccination activities: in addition to moving the second dose forward to 18 months of age (originally six years), they recommend that infants aged 6–11 months living in or travelling to affected areas receive an additional dose.

n0vK1PMSz5qQ025k0OG-RA.zh: 墨西哥截至10/13報告逾1.1萬例疑病例,其中4,915例確診及23例死亡,病例遍及全國22州,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州4,386例為多,該國疫苗覆蓋率為87%,仍低於95%目標,由於兒童疫苗接種率低、農村及周邊地區健康差距大,與此次疫情上升相關。 以色列新增1例死亡病例,該名幼童未接種疫苗,今年迄今累計7例,所有病例均未滿2歲半,目前仍有19例住院,其中4例仍在ICU治療中。
n0vK1PMSz5qQ025k0OG-RA.en: Mexico: As of 13 October, more than 11,000 suspected cases had been reported, including 4,915 confirmed cases and 23 deaths. Cases have been reported in 22 states across the country, most in north-western Chihuahua state (4,386 cases). Mexico's vaccination coverage is 87%, still below the 95% target. Low childhood vaccination rates and large health disparities between rural and surrounding areas are associated with the rise in this outbreak. Israel: One new death was reported, in an unvaccinated young child. So far this year, the cumulative total is seven cases, all of them children under two and a half years old. Currently 19 patients are hospitalized, four of whom remain in intensive care.

QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.zh: 以色列疫情持續,近1週報告4例兒童死亡案例,今年迄今已累計報告6例死亡,該國今年4月爆發疫情,截至9月中旬累計報告超過1,200例,病例多集中於該國中/北部地區。 安哥拉今年迄今累計報告逾6,000例,全國所有省分均有通報病例,該國疫苗覆蓋率已超過70%,惟農村地區及郊區覆蓋率仍低,該國仍持續存在社區傳播風險。 美國今年截至9/23共42州報告1,514例,其中185例住院、3例死亡,並報告40起疫情。新墨西哥州宣布疫情結束,該州自今年2/14爆發疫情,累計報告100例,為該州1996年以來首次爆發疫情,亦為數十年以來最大規模疫情。
QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.en: Israel: The outbreak continues. In the past week, four child deaths were reported, bringing the cumulative number of deaths this year to six. The outbreak began in April this year, and as of mid-September more than 1,200 cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central and northern parts of the country. Angola: More than 6,000 cases have been reported so far this year, with cases reported in all provinces of the country. Vaccination coverage has exceeded 70%, but coverage remains low in rural and suburban areas, and the risk of community transmission persists. United States: As of 23 September this year, 1,514 cases had been reported from 42 states, including 185 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 40 outbreaks had been reported. New Mexico has declared its outbreak over. The state's outbreak began on 14 February this year, with 100 cases reported cumulatively; it was the state's first outbreak since 1996 and the largest in decades.

8c-2rFvIjq1XWruJMWTANA.zh: 以色列今年截至8/27累計報告770例,其中24例住院,多數為6歲以下兒童,另有1名成人,其中2例於ICU治療中,2例死亡,死亡病例沒有潛在疾病,且皆為未接種疫苗之兒童。
8c-2rFvIjq1XWruJMWTANA.en: Israel has cumulatively reported 770 cases this year as of 27 August, of which 24 were hospitalized. Most hospitalized patients are children under 6 years old, and one is an adult. Two patients are being treated in intensive care, and two patients have died. Neither deceased patient had underlying disease, and both were unvaccinated children.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.en: In North Africa, Morocco and Tunisia each reported at least one new rabies death in the fourth quarter of last year. In South Asia, Maharashtra State in India reported at least one new death; the patient had been bitten by a stray dog or cat and, because there was no wound, had not been vaccinated.
